kanazawa-21st-century-museum.name: 21st Century Museum of Contemporary Art, Kanazawa
kanazawa-21st-century-museum.approx_cost: Free public zone; exhibition tickets vary by exhibition, typically ¥500-1,500
kanazawa-21st-century-museum.hours: Exhibition zone 10:00-18:00, Fri and Sat until 20:00 (per japan-guide)

closed.irregular: Closed for major repairs from 6 May 2027 to about March 2028 (planned; the end date is approximate); reason: ageing facilities and damage from the January 2024 Noto Peninsula earthquake

osaka-to-kanazawa.name: Osaka ↔ Kanazawa
osaka-to-kanazawa.approx_cost: Limited express Thunderbird Osaka-Tsuruga, change to the Hokuriku Shinkansen Tsuruga-Kanazawa (since 16 Mar 2024); about 2h30m per one guide. Fare not confirmed (online figures disagree).

tokyo-to-kanazawa.name: Tokyo ↔ Kanazawa
tokyo-to-kanazawa.approx_cost: Hokuriku Shinkansen Kagayaki (all-reserved) about 2h26m-2h30m, ¥14,600 reserved in regular season per a 2026 guide; Hakutaka unreserved ¥14,070 (slower). Other sources: ¥14,120, or ¥14,400 off-peak to ¥15,000 peak.
